name: Bus Breakdown and Delays
description:
This dataset records incidents in which school buses broke down or ran late, with 5,000 sampled rows and 21 columns. Each row captures a single reported incident, including the school year, a unique breakdown ID, the type of run (such as Special Ed AM Run, General Ed AM Run, or Pre-K/EI), bus number, route number, and the schools served. It records the reported reason for the delay—most commonly heavy traffic, followed by "Other," problem runs, and mechanical issues—along with the borough or county where it occurred and the bus company name.

Timing fields include when the incident occurred, when it was created or reported, and when it was last updated. The dataset also notes how long the bus was delayed (in ranges such as 16–30 minutes or 61–90 minutes), the number of students on the bus at the time, and whether the contractor notified schools and parents or alerted OPT (the Office of Pupil Transportation).
